title: Privacy & Security

body.text: on business plans (Team/Enterprise/API), data is not used to train the model by default
— organizations should set a policy for what level of data may go into the AI, and which confidential data must never be entered.

example: "Example policy: public/internal docs → OK / customer personal data, ID numbers, financials → must be masked first"

title: User-side best practices

body.text: remove/replace real names and identifying info before entering · use a plan suited to the data's confidentiality · read the data policy of the plan you use
— data security starts with the user, not just the provider.

example: "Replace 'John Smith, ID 1-2345-...' with 'Customer A' before sending the case to the AI for analysis"

question: How do Anthropic's business plans handle data?

options.text: Not used to train the model by default

question: Before giving customer data to the AI to analyze, what should you do?

options.text: Remove or mask identifying information first
Both the provider and the user

question: What's a good user-side security practice?

options.text: Don't enter more confidential data than needed, and check the data policy

question: Before putting organization data into the AI, what should you do?

options.text: Check that the data can be shared/processed per policy
